description: Shell-and-tube HX (1 shell pass / 2 tube passes, TEMA E) with fouling resistance. Extends F1a (e-NTU) with: UA_eff = 1/(1/UA_0 + R_f_total) where R_f_total = Rf_shell + Rf_tube/A_ratio. Fouling degrades Q and effectiveness.

unit.name: Generic 1-shell 2-tube-pass shell-and-tube HX (water-water, TEMA E)
unit.source: Incropera & DeWitt (2006) ch.11; Shah & Sekulic (2003) ch.9; TEMA Standards 10th ed. Table RGP-T-2.4; Kern, D.Q. (1950). Process Heat Transfer.

Rf_shell_default.note: TEMA RGP-T-2.4 cooling tower water shell side; typical range 0.0001-0.001

Rf_tube_default.note: TEMA treated cooling water tube side; typical range 0.0001-0.001
